The company demonstrates strong profitability with an 85% gross margin and 32% operating margin, generating nearly $3 billion in quarterly net income. However, its highly leveraged capital structure (total liabilities of $274.9 billion vs. equity of $34.0 billion) and a very weak current ratio of 0.35 constrain the rating to the investment-grade boundary, typical of large telecom, media, or highly levered mature tech/pharma firms. 

DECISION: BBB+
